mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE system_code = #{systemCode} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (id, tenant_id, project_id, system_code, doc_code, doc_name, structured_data, owner_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{projectId}, #{systemCode}, #{docCode}, #{docName}, #{structuredData}, #{ownerId}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
INSERT INTO dm_operation_log (tenant_id, actor_id, project_id, operation_code, entity_type, detail_json) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{projectId}, 'STRUCTURED_IMPORT', 'ASSET', #{detailJson})
